content.comment_body: Hello Community, AWS has removed the AWSElasticBeanstalkFullAccess permission. When attempting to upload [product_name] to AWS, the process fails with the following message: Unable to upload WebApp to Amazon S3 To resolve this, you need to create new authorization credentials on AWS. I have described the steps to do this in the attached video. Once authorization is updated, you should follow the workaround outlined in the referenced post: Workaround: Deploy the [product_name] project to AWS I hope this information is helpful. Best regards, [user_name] Support

analysis.insight_summary: Users face a permissions issue when deploying [product_name] projects to AWS, as the AWSElasticBeanstalkFullAccess permission has been removed. This results in failed uploads and blocked deployments. Guidance is offered through a video tutorial and a workaround post to resolve the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a seamless experience when uploading and deploying [product_name] projects to AWS, without running into authorization errors or upload failures.
